response.summary: The intro rewrite is mostly faithful to the plan. Copy, DOM order, video fallback, preview note, container-query layout and neutral token overrides all match it. The scoped HSL values equal index.css lines 118-170. The activity-centre.css warm tokens sit at lower specificity than the override. One acceptance item is missing: the required section-mode student-copy regression test. There is also one low-severity copy deviation and one delivery hazard to keep out of the commit. I did not run tests, typecheck or build, and did not view the images.

findings.evidence: The plan's acceptance section requires 'Add section-mode student copy regression without changing section dispatch.' The changed test files (RelationshipIntro.test.tsx, relationshipPresentation.test.ts) contain no section-mode test. A grep for 'section' in RelationshipIntro.test.tsx returned nothing. ActivityIntro.tsx:53 routes mode==='section' to SectionLaunch. SectionLaunch shows the JSON subtitle and instructions.task that this change edited. Nothing guards that path against the rejected copy returning.
findings.fix: Add a test that renders ActivityIntro with title 'Spot the Relationship', mode='section' and the real JSON instructions. Assert that SectionLaunch (not relationship-intro) renders, that the new subtitle/task text appears, and that the rejected phrases ('signal it', 'Worked example', 'What to write') are absent from student-visible text. The internal coach.drill may keep 'signal it'.

findings.evidence: Plan item 2 specifies step 1 as '**Read the whole sentence.** Decide whether it contains a conditional, causal, or comparative relationship.' The implementation renders step 1 as only 'Read the whole sentence.', and the test asserts /^Read the whole sentence\.$/. The deviation avoids repeating the lead, which the surface brief supports. But the plan was not amended, and the dispositions file does not record it. Step 1 is now a one-line fragment that the lead already covers.
findings.fix: Either restore the plan's second sentence, or record the deliberate removal in the plan or dispositions so spec and code agree. Keep the test and plan consistent.

findings.evidence: The tracked diff replaces the bundled MCP function with an import of the absolute Windows path 'npm:C:\\Users\\Joshu\\dev\\ai-os-projects\\lsatu-relationship-ui\\src\\lib\\mcp\\index.ts' and deletes about 590 lines. If it is committed or deployed, it would break the MCP function. The change manifest still lists it as a changed file.
findings.fix: Stage explicit paths only and verify with 'git show --name-only HEAD' and the push diff that this file is excluded. Do not restore or delete the file, as the plan directs.

Reviewed the container-query and media-query fallback, the focus rule, the fixture file and the test assertions by static reading.

Visual preference and deployment are not established by this review.
